name: Silent One
desc: A person who has listened to the Quiet for too long, and who no longer makes any sound.

intro: You notice the silence first. Then you notice that someone has been standing very close to you for some time.
A person in fleet clothes walks toward you, and their footsteps make no sound, and neither does anything else near them, including you.
hit: They touch you, and the sound of your own heartbeat goes away, and then the pain comes in with no noise at all.
You shout, and nothing comes out of you, and their hand is already on your chest.
Everything goes soft and still, and you're so tired, and then you realize you've been hit.
miss: Their hand passes your face, and you feel the air go dead where it was.
You stagger out of the silence around them, and all the noise of the world comes back at once.
You can't hear your own feet, but you get clear, and they turn to follow you without a sound.
crit: The quiet closes over you completely, and it's the most restful thing you've ever felt, and you have to fight very hard to want to come back.
defeated: They fold up without a sound, and slowly the noise of the room comes back to you.
They lie still with their lips moving. You lean in, and there's nothing to hear.
joins: The noise around you starts to fade on one side, and you turn to find {enemy} standing there.
stunned: {Enemy} stands with their head tilted, listening to something, and the quiet lets go of you.
